== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The cutout of the original slip preserves the Warrior icon of the [[:File:Dagobah-D-corporalderdram-decipher-archive.gif|underlying Decipher card]]. The later slip prints a standalone Pilot icon as well as Warrior. Both include the P2 piloting bonus in their game text. The period rules distinguish an icon outside the game text from a piloting bonus printed inside it.
